statement.zh: 中前古典已存在完整神王制度，并已成定论。
statement.en: Full divine kingship in the Middle Preclassic is settled fact.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: timing and content of divine kingship remain debated; E-Groups and early platforms do not by themselves prove full Classic-style divine kingship.
